components.note: M_{<=1}, vague topology, D=C_c^1, A_psi, B_psi, J (affine payoff), K (ratio payoff) with zero-denominator conventions, I(F)=sup K, I(0)=0, roles of Nature and statistician, subprobability caveat. Source Sec. 8 p.86 game and payoff K checked.

Metrizability via a countable dense family, sequential compactness via Helly and Stieltjes constructions, compactness of a complete totally bounded space written; closure of the contamination class equals {F>=(1-eps)G}, proved in both directions; symmetric version; proper class not closed (delta_n). Source p.88 vaguely compact substochastic class checked.

I=sup J, equality with the restricted positive-denominator supremum, convexity and lower semicontinuity, source Lemma 6 with proof including zero denominators, barycenter membership and mixture inequality proved. Source Lemma 6 pp.86-87 checked.

Both directions written: L^2 density of C_c^1, completeness, representation by a minimal-norm argument, distributional identification F=(H+c)dx, absolute continuity of f, bounds on int|f'| and sup f, bounded variation, I(F)=0 only for the zero measure, singular measures infinite. Source Theorem 3 pp.89-90 checked.

Minimizer existence by lower semicontinuity and compactness; minimax equality via a written finite-dimensional separation and convexity of the square; K>=J and the ratio-game equality; non-attainment example (standard normal) proved. Source Theorem 4 p.90 checked.

Exact convexity-deficit identity, a.e. equality criterion, componentwise constant-ratio characterization, coincidence under a connected union of supports and positive information, zero-information case, positive-everywhere uniqueness, explicit denial of blanket uniqueness. Replaces source Theorem 2(ii) and Theorem 4 uniqueness (pp.88, 90).

Right derivative 2a_g-b_g+r_g-I(f) with the new-support term r_g, the b_g infinite case (minus infinity), absolute convergence of a_g, monotone-convergence justification, and both directions of the minimality criterion. Source J'(0) formula p.87 checked.

Density-based domain (source partial-integration formula, p.86) and weak-derivative domain with a specified bounded representative chi, finiteness requirement, atom values part of the strategy, a.e.-derivative caveat.

Saddlepoint iff K(psi,F*)=alpha and K(psi,F)>=alpha on C, for both domains, with the integration identity verified; absolute-continuity case via the first variation with r_g=0; a continuous real extension forces f*>0 everywhere (integrating-factor argument written).

Both chi cases (C_0, and nonnegative upper semicontinuous vanishing at infinity), boundedness of chi, continuity/upper semicontinuity of a_psi via Lipschitz envelopes, lower semicontinuity of b_psi, b=0 convention case, full saddlepoint; statistical inverse-variance bound under the stated location premises proved. Source Theorem 5 and Remark p.91 checked.
C^2 density, interval support, h=-log g convex, h_k inf-convolution, q_k, Z(k), [t0,t1] with extended endpoints and improper-integral convention. Matches source Sec. 5 Theorem 1 hypotheses p.80.

Nonempty interval, tangent slopes, piecewise tangent-tail formula, infinite-endpoint omission, Z finite/continuous/nonincreasing/strictly decreasing above one, limits, unique k for 0<eps<1, f* positive C^1 in the contamination class, psi_k clipping with int psi_k' <= 2k; all proved. Source normalization (1-eps)^{-1}=int g+(g(t0)+g(t1))/k p.81 checked.

Two formulas for I_*, unique minimization over the proper class and its vague closure, centered class C_k^0, midpoint convex M-estimator consistency, limiting truncated-risk bound without a population derivative, N(0,1/I_*) at F*, all-equivariant minimax via the cross-referenced integrated-score bound, d_F case, symmetric centering, eps=0 endpoint caveat; proof steps written. Source V(psi0,F0) formula p.81 checked.

Logistic: endpoints, Z(k), eps(k), k=1/2 values with I_*=11/60 by two routes, outlier-sample estimate log(7/5); Gumbel: infinite upper endpoint, Z(1), eps, I_*, centering forcing H onto (-inf,-log2], sample estimate -log2. Calculations written and spot-checked arithmetically.
Disjoint-support nonuniqueness with score-extension payoffs 4pi^2 versus 0, step-score derivative failure phi(0), delta_0 infinite information with explicit psi_n; all computed.
